prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: neck strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1295; do not mention it.)
text:
Dear Claims Representative:

This office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was operating a vehicle lawfully when the vehicle driven by your insured crossed into their lane and collided head-on with our client's vehicle. The impact occurred at low speed, but the force of the collision was sufficient to cause a sudden and forceful movement of our client's head and neck.

Following the accident, our client sought prompt medical evaluation and was diagnosed with a cervical neck strain. Treatment has included physical therapy, prescribed medication, and ongoing restrictions on daily activities. Our client continues to experience pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion, and has missed time from work while recovering.

Liability is clear. Your insured's vehicle entered the opposing lane, and the available evidence, including the police report and vehicle damage, supports our client's account. There is no reasonable basis to dispute fault.

Based on the medical documentation, treatment costs, lost wages, and the pain and suffering our client has endured, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve this claim. This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If it is not accepted within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to this office.

Sincerely,

Counsel for [CLIENT_NAME]
